question: What action does the speaker undertake for the destruction of the demons?
premises: The purpose is the destruction of the demons.
The speaker acts in relation to the Brahma-form.
inference: The speaker slays the Brahma-form for the destruction of the demons.
uncertainties: Whether brahmamūrtiṃ is the form assumed by the speaker or the target slain is ambiguous from this verse alone.
plain_english: For the destruction of the demons, I slay the Brahma-form.
